NEW TO THE MARKET
TARMON ROAD, BALLINDRIMLEY, CASTLEREA, CO. ROSCOMMON, F45 TW22

SUPERB 4-BEDROOM DETACHED BUNGALOW WITH DETACHED GARAGE/WORKSHOP

Nigel Dineen & Martin Finn Auctioneers are delighted to present to the market this superb four-bedroom detached bungalow, maintained to an excellent standard throughout and complemented by beautifully landscaped mature gardens, a private south-facing rear garden and detached garage/workshop.

This impressive residence offers bright, spacious and well-proportioned accommodation together with many attractive features, including ornate ceiling lights, feature fireplaces, extensive fitted timber cabinetry and generous built-in storage.

The property enjoys an excellent setting with a tarmac driveway extending to the front, side and rear, beautifully maintained mature gardens and a private enclosed south-facing rear garden.

ACCOMMODATION
Entrance Hall
Wide and spacious entrance hall with fitted carpet, coving and wide PVC entrance door with two glazed side panels providing additional natural light. Feature ornate brass five-arm chandelier with decorative glass shades.

Sitting Room
Fitted carpet, curtains and blind, feature centrepiece ceiling light and wall-mounted lights. Open fireplace with tiled surround and tiled hearth. Large front window overlooking the beautifully landscaped front garden.

Inner Hall
Fitted carpet and coving.

Living Room
Feature fireplace with marble surround, complemented by extensive fitted timber wall panelling, built-in storage and display cabinetry. Fitted carpet, curtains and traditional five-arm chandelier-style ceiling light with decorative glass shades.

Kitchen / Dining Room
Fully fitted kitchen with tiled floor and tiled splashback between units. Stanley range stove which heats the water and radiators, gas hob, electric oven and grill.
Dual-aspect windows with south-facing and west-facing aspects provide excellent natural light.

Storage Area
Located off the kitchen with tiled floor, hot press and additional storage. PVC door providing access to the rear garden.

BEDROOM ACCOMMODATION

Bedroom 1
Fitted carpet, window providing natural light and extensive built-in timber wardrobes and storage units incorporating a vanity area with wash hand basin and tiled splashback.
Ensuite
Fully tiled, WC, WHB with mirror and shaver light, and electric shower.

Bedroom 2
Fitted carpet, curtains and blinds.

Bedroom 3
Fitted carpet, curtains and blind. Built-in timber storage units incorporating vanity area with wash hand basin, tiled splashback, mirror and additional overhead storage.

Bedroom 4
Fitted carpet, curtains and fitted wardrobe.

Main Bathroom
Fully tiled walls and tiled floor. White bathroom suite comprising WC, WHB and bath. Large wall-mounted mirror and window providing natural light.

OUTSIDE
The exterior of this property is a particular feature.
Block boundary walls to the front and side with double entrance gates.

Tarmac driveway extending to the front, side and rear of the residence.
Beautifully maintained mature landscaped gardens to the front with established hedging, shrubbery and colourful planting.

To the rear is a private and enclosed south-facing garden bordered by mature high hedging.
Detached garage/workshop with electric roller door and concrete floor.
Separate fuel shed.
Outside WC and wash hand basin with lino flooring.

GENERAL FEATURES
• Superb 4-bedroom detached bungalow
• Maintained to an excellent standard throughout
• Bright and spacious living accommodation
• Private south-facing rear garden
• Beautifully maintained mature landscaped gardens
• Detached garage/workshop with electric roller door
• Double-glazed PVC windows and doors
• Gas-fired central heating together with Stanley range stove providing a dual heating system
• Mains water and mains sewage
• All furniture can be included in the sale

Tarmon Road, Ballindrimley, Castlerea is a superb family home offering spacious accommodation, beautifully maintained gardens, excellent privacy and extensive additional storage and workshop facilities.

The combination of its mature setting, private south-facing rear garden, generous living accommodation and detached garage/workshop makes this an outstanding opportunity for prospective purchasers and one of the finest properties to come to the Castlerea market in recent times.

Early viewing is highly advised.
Viewing strictly by appointment only with the sole selling agents.
